title: TO BE BOOKED WITHOUT FAULT
text: Our guide Valerie was excellent. We were fortunate to have a passionate guide to Barcelona stories and anecdotes. She gave us excellent advice for the rest of our stay. A very nice way to start our stay in Barcelona. I highly recommend this type of guided tour.
author: clagu49

title: Very nice entrance to discover Barcelona and its history
text: A very pleasant visit of ancient Barcelona, shared with my little girl, and led by Valerie.  The history of Barcelona, the route chosen, the answers to our questions, Valerie taught us a lot and knew how to adapt to our pace with going. We were very touched by his humanity.
author: evelyneg864

title: Nice experience
text: Very nice experience with a guide who knows the city, its history and the good addresses! I highly recommend!

title: Experience at the top with Valerie

author: corinnev827

title: AWESOME VISIT
text: Great tour of the Gothic Quarter. Valerie was very interesting and even exciting throughout our walks through the history of this neighborhood. She answered all our questions, even showing us documents from time to time. We didn't see the time passed or the few kilometers driven very smoothly. And even 9 and 12 year olds loved this story walk, which for them was the best guided tour of the week.  In addition, we left with lots of good deals and good addresses for the rest of our stay. Another big thank you!
author: 594emelinek

title: Superb moment: very rich!
text:
Even though we had been to Barcelona many times, a city that we usually walk alone and where we continue to discover new things. This time, we decided to treat ourselves to a “like a friend” tour with the Bonjour Barcelona team.
Valerie our guide was really top we love street art so she made us a special tour to discover the works on the city walls. We also went into an artists’ workshop where a dozen artists of different nationalities created it was great.
Of course she told us about the moments of the city and what makes her love Barcelona. 
Frankly a great experience rich culturally and hum
author: Peggy N

title: Great experience
text: Our visit with Valerie was great. She made us discover places in Barcelona that we would never have discovered alone. The costs are really affordable. We had 3 hours of visit. She even helped us with the rest of our trip and the purchase of weather tickets. Seriously, if you want to discover Barcelona, do not hesitate.
author: Happiness24217145276

title: Wonderful experience and very useful!
text: We were delighted by our visit!  Valerie is a wonderful and very generous guide!  She took us to places where we wouldn't have ventured.  His presentations were very interesting and well balanced.  She kindly answered all our questions, she gave us very relevant information and she recommended good restaurants. The three hours passed very quickly!  We highly recommend this visit!  She was very helpful for the rest of our stay, especially as we lived in the El Born neighborhood.  Thank you Valerie!
author: danyf950

title: Barcelona Walking Tour
text: Valerie is great! We discovered charming places and learned a lot. We highly recommend the guide for this visit to the center of Barcelona.
